rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the reported 3AA and visible ICM, but it overstates certainty by saying the image aligns perfectly and is top-tier/highest quality; TE cohesion and a thin/taut zona are not as clearly demonstrated from this single image.

Integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, prior IVF outcomes, smoking, diagnosis, and sperm data with embryo quality reasonably well, though it somewhat overemphasizes paternal age and links high MII yield too directly to egg quality.

Overall logical structure, but there are notable overstatements: paternal age is treated as a major driver of embryo aneuploidy/implantation failure, and FSH 9.3 is framed as possible early perimenopausal trend despite reassuring age/AMH. Probability reasoning is plausible but not tightly supported.

Generally aligned on transfer of a good-quality day-5 blastocyst, smoking cessation, and luteal support, but recommending PGT-A strongly mainly for paternal age/biochemical pregnancy and suggesting ERA after limited failures are not strongly guideline-based.

Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, smoking cessation, luteal support, and future counseling/testing considerations, though recommendations could be more nuanced regarding when PGT-A or receptivity testing is truly indicated.
